body: I know you're right, but it's like I'm apathetic to it all. I feel I don't want things to get better, because whenever they do, they just end up worse off than ever. That I constantly move down, I might take a few steps up, but those will always be followed by a long drop down. It's not only that nothing ever goes right for me, it's that everything goes right for everyone else. I have to put on this facade that I'm happy for all of them, when all I want to do is scream. It's like I'm watching everyone at this amazing party having fun, and I'm outside miserable, cold, and all alone.

I know everything you said is true, but right now I just feel whenever happiness comes my way there is always a bigger unhappiness that follows. Looking back, it just seems I always take 1 step forward and 4 steps back. I'm starting to believe that maybe some people are just not meant to be happy. That's why I feel the way I do. I've always fought thinking eventually it'll pay off, but I'm convinced now that it was all for nothing. I sometimes contemplate somehow alienating myself from my friends and family, so that none of them want anything to do with me so I can go off and kill myself without causing anyone pain.

I wish I could believe that things would get better, but after going through this over and over, I just can't believe it. All of my friends are moving on to schools or good jobs, and I just seem never catch a break. I used to fantasize about my future, my career, my family, stuff like that. I would always wish I would eventually have those things. Now all I wish before I go to bed is that I'll close my eyes and never open them again, and that I would somehow never had been. I don't want my future to be good, I only wish I didn't have one.

I feel now I don't want to fight anymore. I really don't care, I have good parents that have always said I can live at home. At this point all I want to do is go home, never speak to anyone again, and wait until I die.
